knobs.note: Read by bin/doorbell-coverage-check.sh as ${DOORBELL_GH:-gh}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible; NOT settable from the control plane — it is a command, a host, a path, an identity or a test seam a root lane uses, so only env/global.env on the box moves it; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/doorbell-coverage-check.sh as ${DOORBELL_RING_H:-24}: the hours window the wakes summary (GET /api/wakes/summary) is asked for when deciding whether the doorbell is ringing (BH-1063); the worker clamps it to 1..168. Registered by BH-1063, the change that introduced the read; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped here.

Read by bin/doorbell-coverage-check.sh as ${WAKES_RETENTION_DAYS:-30}: how many days of `wakes` rows to keep. Once per daily run the lane calls POST /api/wakes/prune, which deletes rows whose `at` is older than this, oldest first, at most 5000 per call (a longer backlog drains over the following days). 0 = off, no prune at all; a non-numeric value prunes nothing and says so in logs/doorbell-coverage-check.log. The worker refuses anything outside 1..3650. Registered by BH-1267, the change that introduced the read.
